overviewTitle: Sign and verify documents with local control.
overviewDescription: Create detached cryptographic signatures without modifying your original files. Your identities and encrypted keys stay on this device.
signDescription: Create a detached signature for a document.
verifyDescription: Check document integrity and signature authenticity.
identityDescription: Manage your dedicated local signing identities.
historyDescription: Review signing and verification activity on this device.
localNotice: NEXUS-Q Sign does not connect to Vault. It has its own identities, encrypted key storage, configuration and history.
signIntro: Choose the original document. A separate .nqsig sidecar will be created next to it.
verifyIntro: Choose the original document and its .nqsig sidecar. Integrity, cryptographic validity and local identity recognition are reported separately.
originalUnchanged: The original document is never modified.
selectBoth: Select the document and its .nqsig sidecar.
desktopOnly: This action is available in the NEXUS-Q Sign desktop application.
signing: Signing the document and publishing its sidecar…
verifying: Checking the sidecar and verifying the signature…
signatureValidRecognized: Valid signature. The identity is recognized on this device.
signatureValidUnknown: Valid signature. The identity is not recognized on this device.
documentChanged: The document does not match the signed digest.
malformedSidecar: The sidecar is malformed or non-canonical.
unsupportedVersion: The NQSIG version is not supported.
unsupportedAlgorithm: The signature algorithm is not supported.
historyNotSaved: The operation could not be saved to history.
identityIntro: Dedicated identities stored locally in NEXUS-Q Sign. Private keys are encrypted and remain under Rust backend control.
passwordNote: The password is sent to the Rust command only to encrypt the seed. It is not stored as identity metadata.
noIdentities: No identities yet. Create one to get started.
creatingIdentity: Generating key material and protecting the identity…
deleteIdentityConfirm: Delete this identity and its encrypted private key? This cannot be undone.
deleteHistoryConfirm: Clear the local operation history? This cannot be undone.
historyIntro: Local metadata only. Documents and full file paths are never stored.
noHistory: No operations have been recorded yet.
backendUnavailable: The desktop backend is not available in this browser session.
errorSelectSidecar: Could not select the signature sidecar.
